title: Design: Authorizer list shows each contact's customer on a second line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B with two authorizer contacts and customer A with one authorizer contact.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-10-after-authorizer-list-top.png, bt-p2-11-after-authorizer-list-bottom.png, bt-p2-09-before-authorizer-list-s2-17577.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Authorizer field on the customer card.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list starts with "No authorizer" on one line.
  • Customer B's contacts follow, each with the contact's name and, on a second line in smaller grey text, customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • Customer A's contact comes last, with customer A's name on its second line.
  • Bill To still shows customer A under the Authorizer field.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12306 (Story 4, Authorizer list when someone else pays)

  • S4-R1: “The Authorizer list shows "No authorizer", then the customer's authorizer contacts, then the Bill To's.”
  • S4-R2: “Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
